t: One Earth Designs, maker of SolSource solar cooker, shuts down after raising $500,000 from Mark Cuban - Tech Startups
s: December 6, 2020 - Back in February 2018, we wrote about SolSource solar cooker after solar tech startup One Earth Designs raised $500,000 from Mark Cuban on the popular ABC Shark Tank show. Everything seemed to be going well until late last year when the Burlingame, California-based startup announced on its website that it would “cease operations as of January 1, 2020.” The company said that customers will still be able to buy its SolSource Solar Cookers from SIC in the US and Asia or from Solar Brothers in Europe.
